skills.evidence: Comfort with basic SQL — simple SELECT/WHERE queries and an understanding of primary keys
Operating systems and Linux fundamentals — basic command-line usage, what a log file is, batch vs. real-time processing
Basic networking knowledge — what an IP address is, client-server architecture fundamentals, and what “latency” means in practice
Strong quantitative and logical reasoning — data interpretation from tables, arithmetic, and structured problem-solving
Excellent communication skills — able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical client, stay calm during an escalation, and document what happened clearly
Prior exposure to a ticketing/incident system
coursework in networking or systems administration
